title: Review of lab 1's ad3-membrane on fresh seeds 5 and 6: planted fuelled droplets build a psi shell (rim/core 3.1/4.1) and multiply by clean fission (11/16 persistent splits, 0 merges), reaching generation 4 on seed 6 and 2 on seed 5
summary: labkit re-runs of threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad3-membrane/world.py on fresh seeds 5 and 6 (frames 200, t=20000, 128^2), with the pack's settings. Two planted droplets grow into rings, break into pieces, and the population multiplies by dumbbell fission to 18 bodies (rerun/seed6/sheet.png, fissions at t~12100-13100). Seed 5: 16 splits, 11 persistent, max generation 2, 0 merges. Seed 6: 16 splits, 16 persistent, max generation 4, 0 merges (original pack: 12/10/14, generation 2/4/4). The amphiphile psi is membrane-like on both seeds (rim/core 3.1 and 4.1, rim/outside 9.8 and 12.4, in 58/63 and 72/76 individuals) and wraps the daughters.

observations.I: rerun/seed6/sheet.png: 18 discrete round droplets persisting t~13000-20000
observations.D: rerun/seed6/FACTS.md: 16 persistent splits, generation 4 from planted founders, 0 merges; seed 5: 11 persistent, generation 2

seeds_run.result: partial: 11 persistent splits but max generation 2 (planted founders need >= 3)

verdicts.limitation: Planted founders; generation >= 3 on 1 of my 2 seeds. I saw the psi shell (rim/core 3-4) but did not run the chi=0 ablation or test lab 1's note that the shell is inert and ~98% explained by |grad phi|^2, so B is not checked here.
